Kate Middleton & Prince William Meet PM Narendra Modi as They Wrap Up India Tour

candidate_claims.text: Return to Homepage Top Stories: Nvidia's record sell-off FBI hacked again Thanksgiving travel forecast Palisades wildfire conviction Last midterms mystery Fiona's necropsy results DOJ drops Alaska lawsuit Trump postpones North Korea visit Senate data center bill Clancy's lawyers appeal (Photo Credit: Pool/Pool / Getty Images) Kate Middleton and Prince William brought their three-day India visit to a close with an important diplomatic engagement.
The Prince and Princess of Wales, both 44, met Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi at his private residence.
The high-profile meeting took place in New Delhi on Wednesday, November 18.
The royal couple traveled approximately 850 miles from Mumbai to New Delhi on a commercial Air India flight for their meeting with the Indian leader.
Their conversation covered opportunities to strengthen the partnership across trade, investment, defence, security, technology, education, and culture.

items.title: Indian Prime Minister Mr. Narendra Modi launches IIT Madras mission to create 3D atlases of 100+ Human Brains

candidate_claims.text: 1-ranked engineering institute, aims to create the world's largest set of whole-human-brain 3D maps at cellular resolution, advancing research into brain structure, development and disease CHENNAI, India , Nov.
18, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Hon'ble Indian Prime Minister Mr.
Narendra Modi launched a path breaking brain research at India's No.
1-ranked engineering institute, the Indian Institute of Technology Madras (IIT Madras).

Narendra Modi on 11th October 2026 launched IIT Madras Sudha Gopalakrishnan Brain Centre's (SGBC) scientific mission to create 3D atlases of 100+ human brains at cellular resolution, spanning the human lifespan from foetal stage to old age, and including brain-related diseases.
